args.title: Document limits for report fields in the API reference
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add explicit mention of the limits on report fields such as maximum recipients in schedule, maximum length of report name, and maximum number of categories. This improves API reference so users can validate inputs correctly before sending requests, avoiding validation failed errors.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue requests listing limits for report fields in the API reference, such as the maximum number of recipients, max length of report name, and max number of categories. These limits exist in the code in src/api/reports.ts in validation schemas but are not documented in the API reference. The file src/api/reports.ts is responsible and a feature label fits.
